sectors.name: Technology
themes: Indonesia's digital economy is structurally under-owned by global funds, creating a catch-up bid once US AI-momentum spills into EM tech baskets.
Local data-center and cloud buildout (driven by sovereign AI mandates and hyperscaler entry) is a multi-year capex cycle independent of US rate cuts.
IDX tech's low correlation to US semis means idiosyncratic catalysts—regulatory easing, digital-bank consolidation—offer alpha not available in US-listed peers.
sectors.ai: Buy Indonesia tech selectively: US AI-hardware names (PLTR, ARM, MRVL) are repricing global risk-on, but ID-listed tech lags at +0.61%—use this divergence to accumulate local AI/digital-infrastructure plays (e.g., data-center, cloud, e-payment) before foreign flows rotate. Favor names with direct US-listing or AI-supply-chain exposure; avoid pure-consumer tech. Trim into strength if IDX tech breaks above 2.5% weekly gain.

Rotate from US-exposed staples into ID-centric FMCG for relative alpha, targeting names with margin expansion from lower input costs and stable rupiah.
